YEDUKONDALU S +91 9391481830 | yedukondalu1992@gmail.com |Hyderabad, Telangana

CAREER SUMMARY

Markets & Securities Services Operations professional with 6+ years of experience across Investment Banking Operations, Securities Operations, Global Custody, Asset Servicing, Fund Accounting, and Capital Markets. Expertise in Trade Lifecycle Management, Trade Capture validation, Trade Settlement, Securities Processing, Daily NAV Validation, Cash & Position Reconciliations, Corporate Actions, and Investment Accounting. Experienced in investigating trade exceptions, resolving settlement breaks, supporting global custody operations, ensuring operational controls, and collaborating with global stakeholders to deliver accurate, timely client servicing. Proficient in Investran, Bloomberg, DTCC, and Advanced Excel.

CORE COMPETENCIES

Markets & Securities Services • Investment Banking Operations • Securities Operations • Fund Accounting • Trade Lifecycle Management • Fund Administration • Investment Accounting • Stakeholder Management

NAV Calculation & Validation • Securities Processing • Cash & Position Reconciliation • Corporate Actions • Trade Settlement • Operational Controls • Process Improvement

Systems & Tools: Investran (SunGard) • Bloomberg • MS Excel (Advanced) • MS Office

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE

STATE STREET | Hyderabad Senior Associate – Private Equity Fund Accounting

Mar 2022 – Apr 2026

Managed end-to-end Fund Accounting activities for multiple Private Equity Master and Feeder Funds within a Markets & Securities Services and Global Custody environment.

Calculated, reviewed and validated Daily, Monthly, Quarterly and Annual NAV, ensuring accurate valuation, accounting, and financial reporting.

Managed the complete investment accounting lifecycle, including trade validation, accounting, settlement monitoring, reconciliation and NAV reporting, ensuring accurate books and records.

Supported Trade Capture validation by reviewing investment transactions, security master information, pricing, accounting entries and trade instructions before accounting and settlement.

Coordinated with custodians, fund administrators and global operations teams to monitor Trade Settlement, investigate settlement failures and resolve operational exceptions within SLA. • Performed Cash, Position, Securities, Bank and Investment Reconciliations, investigating breaks



through root cause analysis and timely resolution. Investigated trade exceptions, failed settlements, cash differences and reconciliation breaks while coordinating with internal operations, custodians and external stakeholders.

Supported Fund Administration activities including investor onboarding, capital calls, investor contributions, distributions, commitment tracking and investor servicing.

Processed investment accounting entries for purchases, sales, accruals, fair value adjustments, realized and unrealized gains and losses using Investran.

• Supported the end-to-end product lifecycle for Private Equity and Fixed Income products, including trade validation, settlement monitoring, investment accounting, reconciliation, corporate actions, and NAV reporting.

• Managed operational activities across the product lifecycle by coordinating with Fund

Administration, Custody, and Operations teams to ensure accurate trade processing, settlement, valuation, and investor servicing.

Reviewed Corporate Actions impacting portfolio investments and ensured accurate accounting



treatment and NAV adjustments. Identified automation opportunities that improved operational efficiency and reduced manual errors.

Ensured compliance with operational controls, fund governing documents, accounting policies and internal risk management standards.

BROADRIDGE FINANCIAL SOLUTIONS | Bangalore Process Analyst – Principal & Interest

Oct 2019 – Feb 2022

Worked in Investment Banking Operations supporting Markets & Securities Services for Fixed Income Securities.

Performed Trade Settlement activities for principal, coupon and maturity payments across Fixed Income securities.

Validated Trade Capture details, settlement instructions, security positions and payment eligibility using DTCC.

Processed securities settlements while ensuring compliance with settlement timelines, client



instructions and operational procedures. Investigated settlement breaks, payment exceptions and reconciliation differences through coordination with counterparties, custodians and internal teams.

Supported Corporate Actions including coupon payments, principal repayments and bond maturities.

Managed the trade lifecycle from Trade Capture validation, Settlement, Securities Processing, Reconciliation and exception resolution for Fixed Income securities.

Supported end-to-end Securities Operations including trade processing, settlements, reconciliations, corporate actions and custody operations.

Delivered Investment Banking Operations support across Fixed Income Securities including trade capture, settlement, securities processing and reconciliation.

Consistently achieved high quality standards while supporting operational risk controls and process efficiency initiatives.

KEY ACHIEVEMENTS

Best Performer Award and Pinnacle Award, State Street — for operational excellence in Private Equity fund accounting.

Achieved 100% quality score for consecutive quarters at Broadridge Financial Solutions.

EDUCATION

Master of Business Administration (Finance) — Malineni Perumallu Educational Society, Guntur

Bachelor of Commerce (General) — Acharya Nagarjuna University

CERTIFICATION

Finance & Skills for Career Certification — SmartSteps Training Academy (2019)

sections.label: Experience
sections.text:
PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE
STATE STREET | Hyderabad Senior Associate – Private Equity Fund Accounting
Mar 2022 – Apr 2026
Managed end-to-end Fund Accounting activities for multiple Private Equity Master and Feeder Funds within a Markets & Securities Services and Global Custody environment.
Calculated, reviewed and validated Daily, Monthly, Quarterly and Annual NAV, ensuring accurate valuation, accounting, and financial reporting.
Managed the complete investment accounting lifecycle, including trade validation, accounting, settlement monitoring, reconciliation and NAV reporting, ensuring accurate books and records.
Supported Trade Capture validation by reviewing investment transactions, security master information, pricing, accounting entries and trade instructions before accounting and settlement.
Coordinated with custodians, fund administrators and global operations teams to monitor Trade Settlement, investigate settlement failures and resolve operational exceptions within SLA. • Performed Cash, Position, Securities, Bank and Investment Reconciliations, investigating breaks

through root cause analysis and timely resolution. Investigated trade exceptions, failed settlements, cash differences and reconciliation breaks while coordinating with internal operations, custodians and external stakeholders.
Supported Fund Administration activities including investor onboarding, capital calls, investor contributions, distributions, commitment tracking and investor servicing.
Processed investment accounting entries for purchases, sales, accruals, fair value adjustments, realized and unrealized gains and losses using Investran.
• Supported the end-to-end product lifecycle for Private Equity and Fixed Income products, including trade validation, settlement monitoring, investment accounting, reconciliation, corporate actions, and NAV reporting.
• Managed operational activities across the product lifecycle by coordinating with Fund
Administration, Custody, and Operations teams to ensure accurate trade processing, settlement, valuation, and investor servicing.
Reviewed Corporate Actions impacting portfolio investments and ensured accurate accounting

treatment and NAV adjustments. Identified automation opportunities that improved operational efficiency and reduced manual errors.
Ensured compliance with operational controls, fund governing documents, accounting policies and internal risk management standards.
BROADRIDGE FINANCIAL SOLUTIONS | Bangalore Process Analyst – Principal & Interest
Oct 2019 – Feb 2022
Worked in Investment Banking Operations supporting Markets & Securities Services for Fixed Income Securities.
Performed Trade Settlement activities for principal, coupon and maturity payments across Fixed Income securities.
Validated Trade Capture details, settlement instructions, security positions and payment eligibility using DTCC.
Processed securities settlements while ensuring compliance with settlement timelines, client

instructions and operational procedures. Investigated settlement breaks, payment exceptions and reconciliation differences through coordination with counterparties, custodians and internal teams.
Supported Corporate Actions including coupon payments, principal repayments and bond maturities.
Managed the trade lifecycle from Trade Capture validation, Settlement, Securities Processing, Reconciliation and exception resolution for Fixed Income securities.
Supported end-to-end Securities Operations including trade processing, settlements, reconciliations, corporate actions and custody operations.
Delivered Investment Banking Operations support across Fixed Income Securities including trade capture, settlement, securities processing and reconciliation.
Consistently achieved high quality standards while supporting operational risk controls and process efficiency initiatives.
KEY ACHIEVEMENTS
Best Performer Award and Pinnacle Award, State Street — for operational excellence in Private Equity fund accounting.
Achieved 100% quality score for consecutive quarters at Broadridge Financial Solutions.
